item.title: Self-Hosted Port Scan Detection: portsentry vs psad vs scanlogd
item.description: Port scanning is often the first step in a network attack. Before an attacker attempts to exploit a service, they probe your server to discover open ports, running services, and potential vulnerabilities. Self-hosted port scan detection tools monitor your network interfaces for scanning activity and can automatically block offending IP addresses before exploitation attempts begin.
